name: The Blue Door (Notting Hill)
description: William Thacker's flat exterior from the hit 1999 film 'Notting Hill'. The house was sold and the original door auctioned for charity at Christie's, but the current door gleams blue again and draws fans daily.
highlight: Hugh Grant's iconic blue door from 'Notting Hill'
address: 280 Westbourne Park Road, London W11 1EH, United Kingdom
